- Timeouts, retries, circuit breakers
- Compensation logic (refunds, rollbacks)
- Dead letter queues or error handling

- External payment processors (Stripe, PayPal, etc.)
- Webhook handlers
- Async messaging (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS)
- Scheduled jobs or batch processes
